stories.title: Number of people in homeless accommodation in Flintshire up 27% in a year
stories.summary: The number of people living in homeless accommodation in Flintshire rose by 27% last year, a report to senior councillors reveals. stories.title: Deeside-based Iceland signs retail letter urging action on youth unemployment
stories.summary: The boss of Deeside-based Iceland is among more than 80 retail chief executives warning the Prime Minister that government policy is making it more expensive to hire young people. stories.title: Ty Calon says vandalism to 3G pitch fencing has cost £2,000 in repairs
stories.summary: A community hub in Queensferry says repeated vandalism to its 3G pitch fencing has cost around £2,000 to repair. stories.title: Figures reveal three fines in three years as Flintshire moves to renew dog control rules
stories.summary: Just three fines have been issued in three years under Flintshire’s dog control crackdown, figures published by the county council reveal. The numbers have emerged as Flintshire County Council prepares to renew its two Public Space Protection Orders, covering dog control and street drinking, before they expire on 29 October. stories.title: Wales imprisons more people than England and most of Western Europe, MPs say
stories.summary: Wales imprisons more of its population than England and most of Western Europe, and MPs are calling for a review to find out why.
